statements.status_notes: brace-expansion@1.1.12 is used by build-time dev dependencies (eslint, glob, jest, etc.) that are not present in the final image. No consumers of brace-expansion@1.x exist in the production node_modules.

brace-expansion@1.1.12 is used by build-time dev dependencies (eslint, glob, jest, etc.) that are not present in the final image. No consumers of brace-expansion@1.x exist in the production node_modules.

Upgrading brace-expansion from 1.x to the fixed version 5.0.5 is a major version jump that breaks plugin bootstrap due to puppeteer postinstall hooks. Waiting for upstream OpenSearch Dashboards plugins to update their dependency.
